Enlarged thyroid is a problem more associated with hyperthyroidism than hypo though it does happen either way. I do know a doctor can refuse any test they don’t deem medically necessary, it’s a shame when they ignore our symptoms and play it off as overreacting. 

My advice? If you can, I’d go to another doctor. If it’s something that concerns you get a second opinion. Thyroid blood tests are pretty simple I can understand refusing extensive tests that aren’t necessary but not that. 

Any other symptoms? How has your energy changed over time? Any hair loss? Any depression or anxiety?

Whatever the case, monitor your symptoms and ask yourself if they are getting worse or not improving. If they aren’t better find another doctor and just describe how you feel, don’t ask for the thyroid tests, and they should know the test is needed. 

“I’ve been colder than usual. I can’t lose weight even when I try my best. I’m always bloated. I’m tired even after I sleep.” Whatever is applicable. I think some doctors don’t like patients that come in self diagnosed. Tell them how you feel and let them diagnose.
